summary: Iteration 15 — Cyna in-app AI mentor. Added /app/backend/tests/test_cyna.py (17 tests: session CRUD, cross-owner isolation, chat with title/project inference, guardrails, action executor, delete cascade). All 17 pass against live Claude via Emergent LLM key. Full regression: 222/222 prior tests still green — total 239/239 backend. Frontend Playwright verified: floating gold bubble on non-/cyna pages, hidden on /cyna, sidebar nav-cyna, full CynaPage with sessions rail, project selector, new session, optimistic user message, live assistant reply. Warm mentor voice confirmed (assistant said 'Hey — welcome back to Neon Heart; let's make something beautiful today.').
critical_code_review_comments: cyna_service.build_project_digest reads db.script_documents/characters/prod_scenes/prod_shots without checking owner_id on nested docs — safe today because entry-point already verifies project owner, but a defense-in-depth filter would be safer.

Every /cyna/sessions/{id}/chat call rebuilds the LlmChat with a fresh session_id (using datetime.now timestamp). Fine functionally but the LlmChat.session_id no longer maps to Cyna's persisted session, so any provider-side session memory is unused. Consider passing the persisted session id.
cyna_create_session accepts payload=None; the FastAPI signature `payload: dict = None` allows an empty POST body — works, but consider a Pydantic model for consistency with the rest of server.py.
server.py has grown to ~2450 lines. Iteration 15 adds 160 more. Recommend splitting Cyna routes into a router file (routes/cyna.py) per the >700-line guidance.
test_credentials: student@cynaiah.demo / Cynaiah2026! (existing). Second student registered dynamically with @example.com domain — the reserved-TLD email validator rejects .test/.demo/.invalid so tests use example.com.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: one TEST_ prefixed finishing_note and one TEST_ prefixed script_document on proj-mv-neon-heart, plus several Cyna sessions/messages for demo-student-001. Not cleaned to preserve replayability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cyna endpoints are stable and Claude 4.5 responses are grounded (mentioned Neon Heart, Aria's project data). If future iterations touch Cyna, re-run pytest backend/tests/test_cyna.py — it's fully self-contained and takes ~30s. Note: the .test TLD is rejected by the email validator; use example.com for synthetic accounts.
